bio: Harmen Ligthart has converted his grandfather's café into a cosy restaurant with an endearing and authentic soul. The view over the IJsselmeer (also from the two luxury guestrooms) is truly stunning! A stroll through the village and down by the boats is a must. Whether you opt for fish or game, you can rest assured that the ingredients are locally sourced and that the classic sense of generosity is adhered to. The pâté and fine Riesling wines are firm favourites here....
